name: ble_remote
title: BLE Remote
description: Keyboard, mousepad and game controller with ten named BLE host slots. Requires BLE-peripheral enabled PAX firmware.
author: PAX workspace
license: Apache-2.0 (app); LVGL MIT; BLE backend GPL-3.0
controls: Mousepad: move, click, drag or scroll
Hosts: connect, pair, rename or forget devices
Close or physical L3: return to launcher
changelog: 0.5.0: full-screen 1024x600 layout with scaled controls and touch targets.
